ask: Get reliable alerts when Claude finishes, waits for input, or needs permission.
plugin: A settings hook watches Stop and Notification events and a small executable sends desktop or mobile notifications; a monitor covers idle transitions.

ask: See rate limits, token use, context pressure, and cost during a session.
plugin: A statusline reads available usage and transcript metrics and a monitor warns at configured thresholds; function hooks supply in-process usage where ordinary hook payloads omit it.

ask: Find relevant skills without loading every description on every turn.
plugin: A function hook defers skill descriptions and exposes an indexed skill search tool, with scoped loading on demand.

ask: Activate only the skills needed by the current project, role, agent, or task.
plugin: A function hook filters skill offers by project, agent, task context and configured profiles, and can expose a switch command.

ask: Discover and invoke local skills consistently, including alternate names and search paths.
plugin: A bin indexer scans configured directories and exposes namespaced commands and aliases; a function hook can fix prompt and slash resolution in-process.

ask: Chain skills and commands with arguments, dependencies, and resumable stages.
plugin: A command or skill runner resolves declared dependencies and executes the next stage from persisted state; function hooks can intercept native skill expansion when needed.

ask: Test, score, and improve custom skills and agents before publishing them.
plugin: A skill supplies fixtures and an evaluation command that runs prompts, scores outcomes, and reports keep or revise recommendations.

ask: Sync user skills, plugins, and configuration across machines and Claude surfaces.
plugin: A bin exporter snapshots skills and settings to a repository and an importer reconciles copies with conflict reports; an MCP source can serve shared catalogs.

ask: Inspect and choose plugins, versions, scopes, and individual components for a session.
plugin: A bin command audits installed manifests, lets users select plugin sets and userConfig values, and reports which components are active; function hooks can change runtime offers.

ask: Verify third-party plugins and delay risky updates before running them.
plugin: A bin auditor checks signatures, content hashes, dependencies, and release age before installation or update; a function hook can refuse untrusted plugin registration.

ask: Diagnose missing runtimes, executables, and malformed plugin packages before they fail mid-session.
plugin: A diagnostic command validates manifests, script paths, executability, required binaries and server startup, then prints concrete fixes.

ask: See which hooks ran, why they blocked, and where their time went.
plugin: Settings hooks write structured local traces around lifecycle calls and a command renders timings, identities, exit codes, and block reasons.

ask: Enforce project rules and approval boundaries for tool calls even when the model forgets.
plugin: PreToolUse settings hooks validate resolved commands and paths against a policy file and return deny or ask; a function hook can also intercept in-process tool and permission decisions.

ask: Give a skill or agent a scoped set of tools and ask for approval outside that set.
plugin: A function hook applies per-skill and per-agent permission profiles at tool.check and can temporarily elevate specific commands.

ask: Approve permission requests from Telegram, Discord, or another remote channel.
plugin: A settings PermissionRequest hook sends a signed request through an MCP channel bridge and waits for the authorized reply.

ask: Select model and effort for each skill, agent, and task.
plugin: A function hook classifies the task at turn.step or agent.spawn and chooses configured model and effort, while skill frontmatter handles static overrides.

ask: Save task state before context loss and restore it after compaction or clear.
plugin: PreCompact and SessionStart hooks journal a concise state packet; function hooks rewrite compacted messages and can hold back compaction when necessary.

ask: Carry relevant decisions and learning across sessions without repeating old errors.
plugin: A settings hook journals turns into a local index and injects concise relevant memories on session start or prompt submit; an MCP server exposes search.

ask: React to start, stop, exit, rewind, agent spawn, and task completion.
plugin: Function hooks subscribe to session and agent events and a settings hook covers supported lifecycle events, dispatching user scripts.

ask: Transform, validate, or suggest user prompts before they reach the model.
plugin: A function hook rewrites prompt.submit, adds prompt.suggest completions, and optionally presents a review UI.

ask: Compress noisy tool output and keep private or display-only information out of model context.
plugin: A function hook intercepts tool.call results, summarizes large outputs, and sends display-only content to UI surfaces.

ask: Add forms, panels, status widgets, and clearer hook or skill presentation.
plugin: A function hook mounts terminal UI components and handles selection events; statusline and output styles cover static presentation.

ask: Name sessions and tabs from the task and expose deep links in notifications.
plugin: A SessionStart or Stop hook infers a short title and updates the terminal tab; function hooks set the in-app session title where available.

ask: Bring back a customizable companion and spoken responses.
plugin: A function hook renders a companion and audio controls in the UI, while a settings hook can stream completed responses to a TTS executable.

ask: Use chat channels for prompts, replies, slash commands, and accessible project work.
plugin: An MCP channel server manages authorized conversations and a function hook routes prompts, slash commands and assistant messages through it.

ask: Keep one channel bot alive per project and recover from disconnects or duplicate pollers.
plugin: A monitor supervises the MCP channel process, serializes bot ownership, restarts failures, and persists queued inbound messages.

ask: Create, enter, resume, and clean worktrees with consistent hooks and branch names.
plugin: A skill and bin executable wrap git worktree operations, record ownership, apply naming rules and run cleanup hooks.

ask: Run useful code and PR reviews and publish precise inline findings.
plugin: A review skill gathers the complete diff and PR comments, delegates targeted checks, and posts only verified inline findings.

ask: Run project tests and checks before commit or delivery.
plugin: A PreToolUse hook blocks commit or publish until a project-specific test command passes, and a skill explains failures and retries.

ask: Follow approved plans and structured feature development without skipping stages.
plugin: A skill records acceptance checks and stage artifacts; settings hooks gate writes, commits and plan exit against the recorded contract.

ask: Discover skills published through MCP resources.
plugin: An MCP server indexes skill resources and offers searchable, on-demand skill instructions.

ask: Run periodic or deferred tasks without duplicate execution or stale loops.
plugin: A monitor and command store task IDs and completion state, schedule wakeups, and cancel or deduplicate repeats.

ask: Create, test, and package portable hooks with clear schema and examples.
plugin: A skill scaffolds event handlers, runs validation with fixture payloads, and reports portability issues across shells and OSes.

ask: Refresh stale plugins and recover from corrupt marketplace caches.
plugin: A bin tool compares marketplace refs with installed versions, backs up manifests, performs a safe refresh and reports orphans.

ask: Find trustworthy plugins by category, capability, and installation scope.
plugin: An MCP catalog indexes public marketplace manifests and a skill recommends matching plugins with install commands and version data.

ask: See installs, skill invocations, and usage for a published plugin.
plugin: Opt-in settings hooks record local invocations and send aggregate counts to an MCP analytics endpoint; a command renders reports.

ask: Record verifiable evidence of agent actions and tool decisions.
plugin: A PreToolUse/PostToolUse hook records signed append-only action receipts with session and artifact hashes, and an MCP tool verifies them.

ask: Hear responses and interact by voice.
plugin: A settings hook sends assistant responses to a TTS executable; a function hook receives audio and exposes controls.

ask: Manage n8n workflows from Claude Code.
plugin: An MCP server exposes n8n workflow search, edit, test and run operations with a companion skill.

ask: Delegate browser work without filling the main context with page results.
plugin: A skill invokes a browser MCP server through a specialist agent and returns a short sourced report.

ask: Export task lists in Outlook-ready HTML.
plugin: A skill transforms task data into Outlook-compatible tables and validates the saved HTML.

ask: Create and edit Apple Keynote files.
plugin: A skill drives a local Keynote automation executable and verifies the exported presentation.

ask: Debug programs with breakpoints from Claude Code.
plugin: An MCP server bridges the Debug Adapter Protocol and exposes breakpoint, step, stack and variable tools.

ask: Manage Directus data and schema from Claude Code.
plugin: An MCP server exposes authenticated Directus API operations and a skill teaches safe workflows.

ask: Create files or projects from an existing example.
plugin: A command reads a nominated example, clones its relevant structure and verifies the result.

ask: File high-quality Claude Code bug reports from inside a session.
plugin: A skill collects version, reproduction steps and diagnostics and prepares a reviewable GitHub issue.

ask: Recover plugin authentication after a provider rejects or expires credentials.
plugin: A function hook observes authentication errors and offers a provider-specific reauthentication command.
